questions.prompt: Pete calls loudly to his family to let them know it is safe. True or False?
questions.evidenceSnippet: He peeks his head out of his burrow underground. He looks around. Then Pete calls loudly to his family, "Yip!" He lets them know it is safe to come out.
questions.evidenceHighlight: He lets them know it is safe to come out.

questions.prompt: Pete is the guard, so he is always looking for danger. True or False?
questions.evidenceSnippet: Pete is the guard and he is restless. He cannot rest because he is always looking around for danger.
questions.evidenceHighlight: Pete is the guard and he is restless. He cannot rest because he is always looking around for danger.

questions.prompt: What animal does Pete see that makes him bark a warning?
questions.evidenceSnippet: Oh no! Pete spies a large badger! When he sees it, he gives a loud bark, "Yap! Yap!" His family recognizes the warning.

questions.prompt: At the end of the day, Pete is still the guard. True or False?
questions.evidenceSnippet: Finally, the sun begins to set and a different prairie dog peeks its head out. I name him Gary. Pete must be off duty.
